name: Hanamaru!
source:
Main character attends a special school deep in the mountains. There is no dormitory for boys there, so he has to board in women's dormitory. He's quite happy about living with cute sempai, but there is one serious problem - there is no men's bathroom! What's going to happen with his school life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角就读于深山特殊学校。那里没有男生宿舍，所以他只能住女生宿舍。他很高兴和可爱的前辈住在一起，但有一个严重的问题——没有男厕所！他的学校生活将会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
